mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever wondered why some new products take off, while others just seem to disappear without a trace? Uncertainty plays a huge role in shaping what succeeds and what doesn’t, leaving even the most experienced business leaders scratching their heads. That’s exactly what Clayton M. Christensen explores in his eye-opening book, Competing Against Luck. Together, we’re going to pull back the curtain on what really drives successful innovation. Instead of chalking up wins to pure chance, Christensen introduces the idea of "Jobs to Be Done." It’s a fresh way of looking at things—one where customers don’t just buy products; they actually “hire” them to solve specific problems or make their lives easier. So, what if you could truly understand why people choose one thing over another? Imagine being able to spot the real reasons behind customer decisions and use that insight to build products people can’t help but love. Throughout our journey, we’ll dive into real-world stories and uncover the hidden patterns that drive consumer choices. You’ll see how companies that figure out the actual jobs their customers need done, end up creating solutions that really stick—long after the hype fades away. By the end of this, you’ll have a whole new perspective on innovation. We’ll explore how you can move past guesswork and turn innovation into something predictable and repeatable, instead of just rolling the dice and hoping for the best. Ready to discover how to compete—and actually win—against the unpredictable forces of luck? Let’s get started on this journey together.
